_why: Skill-candidates row 'run prescribed test-helper blocks against the live module's guards before RED' (2026-09-02). pin-agents-tail-banner prescribed a helper that tripped its target module's own self-source guard; 53 audit cycles passed it. The checker attributes each python block to one existing test module, selects guards by what they do (read their own file, directly or through a name bound to its path or content), runs them with the module's own reads redirected to a scratch copy, and keeps 'could not check' apart from 'checked clean'. Most rows are fail-open or false-FAIL shapes a fresh-context review found in rounds 1 and 2. Each row breaks one property.

mutations.name: mutation-replace-text-is-checked
mutations._mechanism: A mutation row's `replace` text is meant to trip the guard; checking it reports a collision the plan intends. Pinned node: test_a_mutation_replace_block_is_skipped.
